drivingQuestion: What are the circumstances of 'from the trunk' and 'from the roots'?
outcomeNote: The question is answered in the next unit

segments.he: הִגְדִּילוּ – לֹא יְשַׁפֶּה כּוּ׳. הֵיכִי דָּמֵי מִן הַגֶּזַע, וְהֵיכִי דָּמֵי מִן הַשׇּׁרָשִׁין?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: With regard to one who buys two trees in the field of another, if the trees «grew,» the owner of the field «may not cut down» their branches. The mishna further teaches: That which grows out of the trunk belongs to the owner of the tree, but that which grows out of the roots belongs to the owner of the ground. The Gemara asks: «What are the circumstances» in which something is considered to be growing «out of the trunk, and what are the circumstances» in which it is considered to be growing «out of the roots?»
